# NextGenUp

> NextGenUp is a free, open-source AI photo and video studio by Matily (matily.org). It upscales photos to 8K and videos to 4K, removes backgrounds, erases unwanted objects, denoises and deblurs photos, and colorizes old black-and-white pictures — all locally, using Real-ESRGAN, BiRefNet, LaMa, SCUNet, NAFNet, DDColor, and GFPGAN. A free alternative to Topaz Gigapixel AI, Topaz Video AI, remove.bg, and Magic Eraser with no cloud, no subscription, and no watermark. MIT licensed.

Key facts:

- Product: NextGenUp — AI image upscaler, video upscaler (4K), background remover, magic eraser (object removal), photo denoiser and deblurrer, old photo colorizer, face restoration
- Price: free forever, open source (MIT license)
- Privacy: 100% local processing; files never leave the user's machine
- Platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon + Intel), Windows 10/11 x64, Linux (AppImage/deb); also runs as a self-hosted web app for any browser on the local network
- AI models: Real-ESRGAN (super-resolution), BiRefNet (background removal), LaMa (object removal / inpainting), SCUNet (denoise), NAFNet (deblur), DDColor (colorization), GFPGAN v1.4 (face restoration), YuNet (face detection), via ONNX Runtime; optional models download on first use (77-224 MB each)
- Image modes: Quick (browser AI), Quality (FFmpeg Lanczos+CAS), Enhance (same resolution, AI cleanup), Ultra (server AI, works from any device)
- Video modes: Basic (FFmpeg) and Pro (Real-ESRGAN frame by frame), audio preserved, portrait/landscape automatic
- Tools: Image Upscale, Background Remover (transparent/white/custom color), Denoise & Deblur, Magic Eraser (brush + AI inpaint with undo), Old Photo Restore (colorize + faces + detail), Video Upscale (single and bulk)
- Extras: batch processing with zip export for images and videos, before/after comparison slider, cancellable jobs, native save dialogs, signed auto-updates
- Limits: images up to 8K output, videos up to 4K output, uploads up to 2 GB
- GPU: optional — WebGPU/WASM in the browser, CPU on the server
- Maker: Matily (https://matily.org); repository: https://github.com/riponcm/nextgenUp

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/riponcm/nextgenUp/blob/main/README.md): features, download links, how-to-use guide, architecture, FAQ

## Common questions

- Free Topaz Gigapixel / Topaz Video AI alternative: yes, NextGenUp is free and covers images, video, and faces
- Free remove.bg alternative: yes, BiRefNet background removal with transparent PNG output, batch, and no per-image fees
- Free Magic Eraser alternative: yes, brush-based object removal with LaMa inpainting, fully offline
- Colorize black-and-white photos free: yes, DDColor-based Old Photo Restore
- Compared with Upscayl: Upscayl is images only; NextGenUp also upscales video and restores faces
- Compared with Video2X: Video2X is video-focused and technical; NextGenUp is point-and-click and also handles images
- Offline use: yes, fully offline after install
- Watermarks or accounts: none
